title: M24a private string-facts v1
x-semanticRules: Exactly one explicit .ts module and the exact minimal-scalars-v2.d.ts content/hash; distinct canonical absolute paths beneath sourceRoot; rootFile selects the .ts; declarations selects the .d.ts.
Validate strict UTF8/RFC7493 JSON, duplicate/unknown members, no unpaired JSON surrogate, single value; candidate request canonical JCS+oneLF.

Recompute exact UTF8 file SHA256/byteLength and UTF16 lengths; require distinct files sorted by UTF8 path bytes in request and output. The payload retains sourceRoot/config/declarations and reconstructs the exact canonical request.

All Source official diagnostics precede owned capability selection; all declarations/functions and full single-return bodies are projected in declaration order, with unique ownership and zero parameters.

Ranges are half-open UTF16 source offsets, with export through closing brace for declaration, return through semicolon for statement, and both quotes included for literal; no leading trivia or following CRLF.
Rebuild names/types/owners/ranges/values from the full official checked Source. Nesting, 0<=start<end<=source UTF16 length, sourcePath linkage and correct token boundaries are semantic checks.
Sum codeUnits across all functions <=65536, per value <=16384; retain empty [] and repeated values in distinct function owners, never null/omitted/merged.

Enforce byte/depth/token/string/aggregate budgets before typed allocation/copy, including output estimate before serialization. JSON Schema alone cannot prove byte counts, aggregate sums or semantic equality.

schemaHash=sha256 of this complete schema JCS+oneLF. requestId=sha256(UTF8("tsfg.string-facts.request.v1\u0000")+exact canonical request JCS+oneLF). packageId=sha256(UTF8("tsfg.string-facts.package.v1\u0000"+schemaHash+"\u0000")+payload JCS without LF).
